nodes.name: CSS Custom Properties
nodes.content: Design tokens in tokens.css: colors (--color-sea #1342F3, --color-black #222222, --color-white, --bg-light, --bg-light-alt, --bg-border, --color-grey), spacing (--gap-xs to --gap-xl, --section-px 40px), radii (--radius-md 16px, --radius-lg 20px, --radius-xl 30px, --radius-full), type scale (--fs-h1 100px, --fs-h2 70px, --fs-h3 40px, --fs-h4 24px, --fs-body-14/16/18, --fs-numbers 75px), shadows (--shadow-card, --shadow-hover), breakpoints (--bp-mobile 375px, --bp-tablet 768px, --bp-desktop 1920px)

nodes.name: Shared CSS Components
nodes.content: Reusable UI components in components.css: .container (1790px), .card/.card--company/.card--partner/.card--project/.card--webinar (668/930/460px), .btn/.btn--primary/.btn--outline/.btn--outline-white/.btn--outline-dark/.btn--ghost/.btn--white/.btn--black/.btn--search (50px radius), .carousel-nav/__btn, .tabs/.tabs__btn (data-tab), .section-title/.section-label/.body-text

nodes.name: CSS Utilities
nodes.content: Reset styles (*box-sizing, margin, padding), typography (h1-h6, p, a, img, ul), .truncate (text-overflow ellipsis), .is-hidden/.is-visible (display none/flex)

nodes.name: CSS Sections
nodes.content: Page-specific layout in sections.css: .header, .hero, .industries, .stats, .tasks, .clients, .partners, .projects, .events, .cta, .footer. Megafile with 500+ lines. Contains prefers-reduced-motion media query. TODO: split into per-section files

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.content: Homepage: hero, industries (4 cards -> solutions.html), stats (5 columns), tasks (6 links hover-bg), clients (10 logos JS-rendered), partners (5 cards carousel), projects (3 cards -> projects.html), events (4 cards carousel), CTA. Inline SVG logo, icon sprite, Swiper, Google Fonts Inter

nodes.name: solutions.html
nodes.content: Solutions catalog: .page-hero (breadcrumbs + h1), .catalog (6 solution cards, grid layout, --single modifier), .cta. Cards link to solution-detail.html

nodes.name: solution-detail.html
nodes.content: Detailed solution: hero, registry, tasks (accordion), audience (4 cards), features (tabs data-tab 0-4, panel switching), cta--dark, testimonials (swiper), events--readalso, faq. Only page importing fancybox.css + jQuery

nodes.name: clients.html
nodes.content: Clients listing: page-hero--media, .c-clients (JS-rendered), .projects .c-projects, .cta

nodes.name: client-detail.html
nodes.content: Client detail: page-hero--detail, client-intro, stats--client (3 columns), client-quote, stages (timeline), cta--blue, events--readalso

nodes.name: projects.html
nodes.content: Projects catalog: page-hero, .projects__filters (3 dropdowns: Otresli/Resheniya/Produkty), .projects__grid (6 cards 930x460), .projects__more, .cta

nodes.name: project-detail.html
nodes.content: Project detail: page-hero, .project-intro (back link, stats--project 4 cols, video), .project-about (quote, content, sidebar images), .project-gallery (--mosaic 3-col), .project-partners (collapsible table), .cta

nodes.name: events.html
nodes.content: Media center: page-hero--media, .events-featured, .events-list, .cta

nodes.name: event-detail.html
nodes.content: Event detail: event-hero, event-about, audience, program, cta--blue, seminar-topics, event-partners, trust, clients, faq

nodes.name: directum.html
nodes.content: Directum digital ecosystem page

nodes.name: univer-online.html
nodes.content: Univer Online ecosystem: hero, univer-registry, audience, reasons--univer, cta--blue--univer, services, projects--univer, vnedrenie--univer, team, cta, footer

nodes.name: vuz.html
nodes.content: University digital transformation page

nodes.name: js/main.js
nodes.content: Single JS file: initSwiper (hero/partners/events/galleries 617/618/460px), bindNav (hamburger), initAccordion (tasks), initClientsPage (filter/render/detail/quote from JSON), initProjectsPage (filter/render), initNewsPage (events from JSON), initTabs (data-tab switching)

nodes.name: Swiper.js
nodes.content: Local copy: assets/vendor/swiper/ (swiper-bundle.min.js + min.css). Instances: hero (617px), partners (460px), events (617px), galleries on project-detail (617/618/460px). Nav via .carousel-nav buttons

nodes.name: Google Fonts (Inter)
nodes.content: External: preconnect fonts.googleapis.com + fonts.gstatic.com, css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700. Loaded in every page via <link>

nodes.name: Fancybox
nodes.content: Lightbox library. Imported in solution-detail.html and project-detail.html

nodes.name: jQuery
nodes.content: jQuery loaded in solution-detail.html and project-detail.html (for fancybox)

nodes.name: 4-File CSS Architecture
nodes.content: tokens.css (variables) -> utilities.css (reset/typo) -> components.css (shared UI) -> sections.css (page layout). Dedicated CSS per detail page (solution.css, project.css, event.css, univer.css)

nodes.name: Static Page Routing
nodes.content: Multi-page static site: all HTML in root. Links: solutions->solution-detail, clients->client-detail, projects->project-detail, events->event-detail. No JS router

nodes.name: Figma Dual Source of Truth
nodes.content: Figma=visual design truth, Code=implementation structure truth. Workflow: FIGMA_AUDIT -> FIGMA_IMPLEMENT -> FIGMA_QA. Section-as-task with subagents. Registry in FIGMA.md

nodes.name: BEM Naming Convention
nodes.content: Block__Element--Modifier: .carousel-nav__btn, .card--partner, .btn--primary, .tabs__btn.is-active. Section classes: .hero, .industries, .stats, .tasks, .clients, .partners, .projects, .events, .cta, .footer

nodes.name: Component Reuse Rules
nodes.content: Before new component: 1) search codebase, 2) check equivalent, 3) check Figma variant. Figma naming != code. Blue Button -> .btn--primary. Component Registry in AGENTS.md

nodes.name: Inline SVG Icon System
nodes.content: Inline SVG per page (Figma vectorPaths). Arrow sprite: #icon-arrow (17x14, fill=currentColor), #icon-arrow-right (15x14). Use <use href>, not text arrow

nodes.name: Google Fonts Inter
nodes.content: Inter 400/500/600/700 via Google Fonts <link> in every page. No local woff2. --font-heading/inter, --font-body/Inter

nodes.name: JSON Data Flow
nodes.content: Clients/projects/news rendered from JSON via fetch+render, not static HTML. Projects page: clients.json filtered by project_ids. Architectural detail, not changed during Figma verification

nodes.name: Reduced Motion
nodes.content: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce disables transitions. Some elements override with !important. CSS media query in sections.css and page stylesheets

nodes.name: Section Implementation Status
nodes.content: FIGMA.md tracks per-section status (done/in-progress/pending). All main page sections done. Detail pages done. Parallel pages (univer, vuz, directum) done

nodes.name: Outstanding TODOs
nodes.content: 1) Split sections.css (500+ lines) into per-section files. 2) Fix missing favicon.ico (404 on homepage)

hyperedges.name: CSS Architecture Stack
hyperedges.content: Complete CSS architecture: tokens define variables, utilities reset and set base typography, components provide shared UI, sections handle page layout. Loading order matters for cascade

hyperedges.name: Page Dependency Graph
hyperedges.content: All pages depend on CSS tokens/components and js-main. index.html and detail pages also depend on Swiper and Google Fonts. solution-detail and project-detail uniquely depend on Fancybox+jQuery

hyperedges.name: Core Architecture Concepts
hyperedges.content: Fundamental architecture decisions governing the codebase: CSS layering, static routing, Figma integration, BEM naming, component reuse, inline SVG icons, Inter font, JSON data rendering, accessibility motion preferences, implementation tracking, and remaining technical debt
